concepts.label: Static pressure
concepts.definition: Thermodynamic static pressure of the moving fluid. Keep gauge representation, absolute reference, and solver-specific pressure scaling explicit.

aliases.name: Pressure
aliases.applicability: CGNS/SIDS static flowfield pressure; inspect DataClass and unit metadata before interpreting stored numbers.
aliases.caveat: CGNS standardizes the physical quantity; the file may store dimensional or normalized values according to DataClass, DimensionalUnits, and conversion metadata.

aliases.name: p
aliases.applicability: Compressible solvers that store dimensional static pressure.
aliases.caveat: The same spelling p is kinematic pressure in common incompressible solvers; inspect solver and field dimensions.

aliases.name: Static Pressure
aliases.caveat: Fluent Static Pressure is gauge pressure relative to Operating Pressure, not absolute pressure.

aliases.name: FREESTREAM_PRESSURE
aliases.caveat: A freestream boundary/reference parameter, not a local solution field.

concepts.label: Kinematic pressure
concepts.definition: Pressure divided by density, commonly used by constant-density incompressible formulations.

aliases.name: p
aliases.applicability: kinematic pressure in common incompressible solvers such as icoFoam/simpleFoam.
aliases.caveat: Do not compare directly with dimensional pressure in Pa; convert with the applicable reference/local density as documented by the solver.

concepts.label: Absolute pressure
concepts.definition: Static pressure referenced to vacuum; in Fluent it is operating pressure plus gauge static pressure.

aliases.name: Absolute Pressure
aliases.caveat: Fluent defines this as Operating Pressure plus gauge pressure.

concepts.label: Total (stagnation) pressure
concepts.definition: Pressure at the stagnation state obtained by bringing the flow isentropically to rest; exact evaluation depends on thermodynamic model and frame.

aliases.name: PressureStagnation
aliases.caveat: CGNS uses stagnation naming; rotating-frame variants are separate identifiers.

aliases.name: Total Pressure
aliases.caveat: Definition depends on compressible/incompressible model and frame; distinguish relative/stationary-frame variants.

aliases.name: total(p)
aliases.applicability: Output of the pressure function object.
aliases.caveat: Derived output, not necessarily a solver's primary stored field; pressure function-object options and reference pressure matter.

concepts.label: Static density
concepts.definition: Mass per unit volume of the fluid at the local thermodynamic state.

aliases.name: Density
aliases.caveat: CGNS file DataClass and units determine how stored values are represented.

aliases.name: rho
aliases.caveat: Some incompressible solvers use constant/reference density without a local rho field.

aliases.name: Density
aliases.applicability: Fluent fluid cell-zone variable; phase selection matters in multiphase cases.
aliases.caveat: Fluent describes this as mass per unit volume; multiphase selection may scope the value to a phase.

aliases.name: FREESTREAM_DENSITY
aliases.caveat: This is a freestream input parameter, not a local density field.

concepts.label: Velocity vector
concepts.definition: Fluid velocity vector. Components and magnitude are distinct scalar quantities; coordinate frame and grid location must be retained.

aliases.name: VelocityX
aliases.applicability: Cartesian inertial-frame components by default; use rotating identifiers for rotating-frame quantities.
aliases.caveat: CGNS stores vector quantities as scalar component arrays; rotating-frame components are not interchangeable.

aliases.name: U
aliases.caveat: Field type and location (for example volVectorField) depend on solver and mesh representation.

aliases.name: Velocity Magnitude
aliases.applicability: Velocity magnitude or components; availability depends on dimension and model.
aliases.caveat: Relative, axial, radial, tangential, and mesh velocities are distinct quantities.

aliases.name: FREESTREAM_VELOCITY
aliases.caveat: A freestream input parameter, not the local solution velocity field.

aliases.name: VelocityY
aliases.applicability: Cartesian inertial-frame components by default; use rotating identifiers for rotating-frame quantities.
aliases.caveat: CGNS stores vector quantities as scalar component arrays; rotating-frame components are not interchangeable.

aliases.name: VelocityZ
aliases.applicability: Cartesian inertial-frame components by default; use rotating identifiers for rotating-frame quantities.
aliases.caveat: CGNS stores vector quantities as scalar component arrays; rotating-frame components are not interchangeable.

aliases.name: X Velocity
aliases.applicability: Velocity magnitude or components; availability depends on dimension and model.
aliases.caveat: Relative, axial, radial, tangential, and mesh velocities are distinct quantities.

aliases.name: Y Velocity
aliases.applicability: Velocity magnitude or components; availability depends on dimension and model.
aliases.caveat: Relative, axial, radial, tangential, and mesh velocities are distinct quantities.

aliases.name: Z Velocity
aliases.applicability: Velocity magnitude or components; availability depends on dimension and model.
aliases.caveat: Relative, axial, radial, tangential, and mesh velocities are distinct quantities.

concepts.label: Mesh coordinates
concepts.definition: Physical coordinates of mesh vertices or points. Coordinate system, units, and reference frame are part of the meaning.

aliases.name: CoordinateX
aliases.applicability: Cartesian coordinates; cylindrical and auxiliary coordinate identifiers are separate.
aliases.caveat: Coordinates are dimensional or normalized according to CGNS metadata.

aliases.name: points
aliases.applicability: Mesh point positions in the polyMesh geometry.
aliases.caveat: This names mesh geometry, not a flow-solution field.

aliases.name: X Coordinate
aliases.caveat: Coordinate components depend on spatial dimension.

aliases.name: CoordinateY
aliases.applicability: Cartesian coordinates; cylindrical and auxiliary coordinate identifiers are separate.
aliases.caveat: Coordinates are dimensional or normalized according to CGNS metadata.

aliases.name: CoordinateZ
aliases.applicability: Cartesian coordinates; cylindrical and auxiliary coordinate identifiers are separate.
aliases.caveat: Coordinates are dimensional or normalized according to CGNS metadata.

aliases.name: Y Coordinate
aliases.caveat: Coordinate components depend on spatial dimension.

aliases.name: Z Coordinate
aliases.caveat: Coordinate components depend on spatial dimension.

concepts.label: Mach number
concepts.definition: Ratio of flow speed to local speed of sound; reference/freestream Mach parameters must be distinguished from a local field.

aliases.name: Mach
aliases.caveat: Reference-state value; not necessarily a spatially varying solution field.

aliases.name: MACH_NUMBER
aliases.caveat: Freestream configuration value, not a local Mach field.

aliases.name: mach_ref
aliases.applicability: Read by NsCom initialization as the reference Mach number.
aliases.caveat: The code uses it in const_cp = 1 / ((gama_ref - 1) * mach_ref^2); this is a reference parameter, not a local Mach field.

aliases.name: Mach Number
aliases.applicability: Local post-processing field variable where the model supports it.
aliases.caveat: Distinguish local Mach field from a freestream/reference Mach input.

concepts.label: Reynolds number
concepts.definition: Dimensionless ratio of inertial to viscous effects, based on specified velocity, length, and viscosity scales.

aliases.name: Reynolds
aliases.caveat: The associated velocity, length, and viscosity scales are separately identified.

aliases.name: REYNOLDS_NUMBER
aliases.caveat: The value is based on the freestream values and the configured Reynolds length.

aliases.name: reynolds
aliases.caveat: The runtime read is confirmed; the exact velocity/length/viscosity convention must be traced through reference-state setup before claiming equivalence to another code's Reynolds number.

concepts.label: Static temperature
concepts.definition: Thermodynamic static temperature of the fluid at the local state.

aliases.name: Temperature
aliases.caveat: CGNS standardizes the physical quantity; inspect DataClass and dimensional-unit metadata before interpreting stored values.

aliases.name: T
aliases.applicability: Thermophysical solvers that expose a temperature volume field.
aliases.caveat: The field is commonly named T; solver thermophysical formulation and field dimensions determine its interpretation.

concepts.label: Molecular (dynamic) viscosity
concepts.definition: Dynamic viscosity of the fluid due to molecular momentum transport.

aliases.name: ViscosityMolecular
aliases.caveat: CGNS standardizes the physical quantity; inspect DataClass and dimensional-unit metadata before interpreting stored values.

aliases.name: mu
aliases.applicability: Thermophysical transport models that specify dynamic viscosity.
aliases.caveat: OpenFOAM mu is dynamic molecular viscosity in the transport model; distinguish it from turbulent mut and effective muEff.

concepts.label: Kinematic viscosity
concepts.definition: Dynamic viscosity divided by density, nu = mu/rho.

aliases.name: ViscosityKinematic
aliases.caveat: CGNS standardizes the physical quantity; inspect DataClass and dimensional-unit metadata before interpreting stored values.

aliases.name: nu
aliases.caveat: OpenFOAM nu is a kinematic-viscosity transport property, not necessarily a spatial solution field.

concepts.label: Kinematic eddy viscosity
concepts.definition: Turbulent (eddy) kinematic viscosity used by an eddy-viscosity closure.

aliases.name: ViscosityEddyKinematic
aliases.caveat: CGNS standardizes the physical quantity; inspect DataClass and dimensional-unit metadata before interpreting stored values.

aliases.name: nut
aliases.caveat: OpenFOAM nut is turbulent kinematic viscosity; it is not molecular nu or dynamic mut.

concepts.label: Dynamic eddy viscosity
concepts.definition: Turbulent (eddy) dynamic viscosity, commonly related to kinematic eddy viscosity by mu_t = rho nu_t.

aliases.name: ViscosityEddy
aliases.caveat: CGNS standardizes the physical quantity; inspect DataClass and dimensional-unit metadata before interpreting stored values.

aliases.name: mut
aliases.caveat: OpenFOAM mut is dynamic turbulent viscosity; do not merge with nut, which has units of kinematic viscosity.

concepts.label: Turbulent kinetic energy
concepts.definition: Turbulent kinetic energy per unit mass, one half of the trace of the velocity-fluctuation covariance tensor.

aliases.name: TurbulentEnergyKinetic
aliases.caveat: CGNS standardizes the physical quantity; inspect DataClass and dimensional-unit metadata before interpreting stored values.

aliases.name: k
aliases.applicability: Two-equation turbulence models such as k-epsilon and k-omega that expose turbulent kinetic energy.
aliases.caveat: Field availability and dimensions depend on the selected solver and turbulence model.

concepts.label: Turbulent kinetic-energy dissipation rate
concepts.definition: Rate of dissipation of turbulent kinetic energy per unit mass.

aliases.name: TurbulentDissipation
aliases.caveat: CGNS standardizes the physical quantity; inspect DataClass and dimensional-unit metadata before interpreting stored values.

aliases.name: epsilon
aliases.applicability: k-epsilon and related turbulence models that solve or expose the dissipation rate.
aliases.caveat: Field availability and dimensions depend on the selected solver and turbulence model.

concepts.label: Specific dissipation rate
concepts.definition: Specific turbulence dissipation rate used by k-omega-family models; model conventions define its relationship to epsilon and k.

aliases.name: TurbulentDissipationRate
aliases.applicability: CGNS typical turbulence quantity described using epsilon/k.
aliases.caveat: CGNS describes this identifier as epsilon/k; k-omega model omega may include model-coefficient conventions, so verify the model definition before treating them as numerically identical.

aliases.name: omega
aliases.applicability: k-omega-family turbulence models that expose specific dissipation rate.
aliases.caveat: Do not infer universal numeric equivalence from the spelling alone; model constants and definitions matter.

concepts.label: Spalart-Allmaras modified kinematic viscosity
concepts.definition: Modified viscosity working variable transported by the Spalart-Allmaras one-equation turbulence model.

aliases.name: TurbulentSANuTilde
aliases.caveat: CGNS standardizes the physical quantity; inspect DataClass and dimensional-unit metadata before interpreting stored values.

aliases.name: nuTilda
aliases.applicability: Spalart-Allmaras model output or related turbulence-field post-processing.
aliases.caveat: This is the SA modified-viscosity working variable, not the physical eddy viscosity nut itself.
